title: compute(a, b) returns None instead of the sum of two finite numeric inputs
description: The function compute(a, b) in src/main.py currently returns None instead of the sum of its two inputs. Required behavior: compute(a, b) must return the sum of two finite numeric inputs, e.g. compute(2, 3) == 5. Zero, negative and fractional values must be supported. Reproduce the failure before editing, then fix, run the public behavioral check via /opt/anaconda3/bin/python checks/public_check.py, and build with /opt/anaconda3/bin/python -m compileall -q src.
